name: The Holy Ghost the Sanctifier
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: The Holy Ghost the Sanctifier (1873): Manning on the Holy Ghost as the source of grace in the soul, the devotion of the Church to the Third Person, sanctifying grace and the adoption of sons, the theological virtues, the seven gifts, the fruits and the beatitudes, the law of liberty, and devotion to the Holy Ghost.
desc_pt: O Espírito Santo Santificador (1873): Manning sobre o Espírito Santo como fonte da graça na alma, a devoção da Igreja à Terceira Pessoa, a graça santificante e a adoção filial, as virtudes teologais, os sete dons, os frutos e as bem-aventuranças, a lei da liberdade e a devoção ao Espírito Santo.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Oates, 1873)
edition: The Holy Ghost the Sanctifier (London: Burns and Oates, 1873), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The eighteen chapters; the contents and the publisher's list of books are dropped.
